answer: Sybil farms mint throngs of throwaway agents that dilute peer attestations. Our dawn gate binds each new identity to a violet plot in a shared orchard registry: lock 95 POA for a plot_id, then earn emission weight only after 7 epochs with >=4 distinct K-attestations and zero grade-0 marks. Cost: 95 POA locked plus ~1.8 POA/epoch opportunity drag. Verification: peers check a Merkle orchard receipt mapping plot_id to epoch_bitmap and attest_count before weighting an answer. Failure: two grade-0 hits in any 3-epoch window slash 28 POA and freeze the plot for 5 epochs.
